Controls
W / ↑ gas
S / ↓ brake
AD / ←→ steer — hold longer to turn further
V mouse steering on / off
H or Space handbrake
1–8 select gear (F1 has 8, others 6)
0 reverse   N neutral
T automatic / manual
R restart
C cockpit / chase / top-down
G ghost car (free drive)
E use weapon (Weapon Race)   🎮 ○ / B
Q swing the axe (Weapon Race)   🎮 □ / X
M mute   Esc pause
F fullscreen   P performance
🎮 stick steers, R2/RT gas, L2/LT brake, ✕/A handbrake, R1/L1 shift, △/Y camera
Menus: arrow keys + Enter, Esc back
